source_text: \subsection{{Harmonic forms, the Hodge decomposition, and the Poincaré inequality}}\label{sec:harmonic-hodge-poincare}
translated_text: \subsection{{调和形式, Hodge 分解与 Poincaré 不等式}}\label{sec:harmonic-hodge-poincare}

source_text: {Next we derive several simple, but crucial, consequences of the Hilbert space structure. In this section, we assume that $(W,d)$ is a Hilbert complex, which is not necessarily closed.}
translated_text: {接下来推导 Hilbert 空间结构的几个简单而关键的推论. 本节假设 $(W,d)$ 是 Hilbert 复形, 不一定是闭的.}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Harmonic forms}}\label{subsec:harmonic-forms}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{调和形式}}\label{subsec:harmonic-forms}

source_text: {Thus the harmonic forms give a concrete realization of the cohomology of the complex as a closed subspace of the Hilbert space $W^k$. This is illustrated in Figure~\ref{fig:cohomology-harmonic-representatives}. The elements of the cohomology space $\mathcal H^k$ are the equivalence classes of elements of $\mathcal Z^k$ modulo $\mathcal B^k$. These provide a decomposition of $\mathcal Z^k$ into closed affine subspaces obtained from $\mathcal B^k$ by translation. Each such subspace contains a distinguished element, namely, the unique element orthogonal to $\mathcal B^k$, which is also characterized as the unique element of the smallest norm. These are the harmonic $k$-forms.}
translated_text: {因此, 调和形式将复形的上同调具体实现为 Hilbert 空间 $W^k$ 的一个闭子空间. Figure~\ref{fig:cohomology-harmonic-representatives} 展示了这一点. 上同调空间 $\mathcal H^k$ 的元素是 $\mathcal Z^k$ 的元素模 $\mathcal B^k$ 的等价类. 这些等价类将 $\mathcal Z^k$ 分解为由 $\mathcal B^k$ 平移得到的闭仿射子空间. 每个这样的子空间都含有一个特殊元素, 即唯一与 $\mathcal B^k$ 正交的元素, 它也可刻画为唯一的最小范数元素. 这些就是调和 $k$-形式.}

source_text:
{We may use harmonic forms to obtain a useful criterion for a Hilbert complex to be Fredholm, i.e., for its homology spaces to be finite. The space $V^k\cap V_k^*\subset W^k$ is a Hilbert space when endowed with the norm}
\[
\|v\|_{V\cap V^*}^2=\|v\|_V^2+\|v\|_{V^*}^2=2\|v\|^2+\|dv\|^2+\|d^*v\|^2.
\]
translated_text:
{可利用调和形式得到 Hilbert 复形为 Fredholm 的一个有用判据, 即其同调空间为有限的判据. 空间 $V^k\cap V_k^*\subset W^k$ 配备下述范数后是 Hilbert 空间:}
\[
\|v\|_{V\cap V^*}^2=\|v\|_V^2+\|v\|_{V^*}^2=2\|v\|^2+\|dv\|^2+\|d^*v\|^2.
\]

source_text: {Here and below, we write $\|\cdot\|_V$ for the norm in each of the spaces $V^k$, $\|\cdot\|_{V^*}$ for the norm in the spaces $V_k^*$, and simply $\|\cdot\|$ for the norm in the spaces $W^k$.}
translated_text: {这里及下文, 用 $\|\cdot\|_V$ 表示各空间 $V^k$ 中的范数, 用 $\|\cdot\|_{V^*}$ 表示空间 $V_k^*$ 中的范数, 并简单地用 $\|\cdot\|$ 表示空间 $W^k$ 中的范数.}

source_text:
\begin{Proof}
{We first check that $d$ has closed range. Let $T$ be the restriction of $d$ to $D(T):=V\cap\mathcal Z^\perp$, viewed as an unbounded operator $W\to W$. It is easy to check that the range of $T$ coincides with the range of $d$ and, since $d$ is a closed operator, $T$ is closed as well. Since $\mathcal Z^\perp=\overline{\mathcal B}^*\subset\mathcal Z^*\subset V^*$, $D(T)\subset V\cap V^*$ and the graph norm on $D(T)$ is equivalent to the $V\cap V^*$ norm. By Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-domain-closed-range}, $T$, and thus $d$, has closed range.}
translated_text:
\begin{Proof}
{先验证 $d$ 的像空间是闭的. 设 $T$ 为 $d$ 在 $D(T):=V\cap\mathcal Z^\perp$ 上的限制, 视为无界算子 $W\to W$. 容易验证 $T$ 的像空间与 $d$ 的像空间相同, 且由于 $d$ 是闭算子, $T$ 也闭. 由于 $\mathcal Z^\perp=\overline{\mathcal B}^*\subset\mathcal Z^*\subset V^*$, 有 $D(T)\subset V\cap V^*$, 且 $D(T)$ 上的图范数与 $V\cap V^*$ 范数等价. 由 Theorem~\ref{thm:compact-domain-closed-range}, $T$ 从而 $d$ 均有闭像空间.}

source_text:
{Next, we note that, on $\mathsf H\subset V\cap V^*$, the $V\cap V^*$ norm is equivalent to the $W$ norm. Thus the closed unit ball in $\mathsf H$ is compact, which implies that $\mathsf H\cong\mathcal H$ is finite dimensional, i.e., the complex is Fredholm.}
\end{Proof}
translated_text:
{其次注意, 在 $\mathsf H\subset V\cap V^*$ 上, $V\cap V^*$ 范数与 $W$ 范数等价. 因此 $\mathsf H$ 中的闭单位球是紧的, 这意味着 $\mathsf H\cong\mathcal H$ 为有限维, 即该复形是 Fredholm 的.}
\end{Proof}

source_text: \subsubsection{{Hodge decomposition}}\label{subsec:hodge-decomposition}
translated_text: \subsubsection{{Hodge 分解}}\label{subsec:hodge-decomposition}

source_text: {The Hilbert complex structure leads directly to the Hodge decomposition, a generalization of the Helmholtz decomposition of vector calculus.}
translated_text: {Hilbert 复形结构直接导出 Hodge 分解, 它是向量微积分中 Helmholtz 分解的推广.}

source_text: {For a closed Hilbert complex we may, of course, drop the bars over the boundary spaces. In this case, the Hodge decomposition says that every element of $W$ has a unique decomposition into an element of the range of $d$, an element of the range of $d^*$, and a harmonic form, and this decomposition is orthogonal.}
translated_text: {对闭 Hilbert 复形, 当然可以去掉边界链空间上的横线. 此时, Hodge 分解说明 $W$ 的每个元素都唯一地分解为 $d$ 的像中的一个元素, $d^*$ 的像中的一个元素以及一个调和形式, 且该分解是正交的.}

source_text: \subsubsection{Poincaré {inequality}}\label{subsec:hilbert-poincare-inequality}
translated_text: \subsubsection{Poincaré {不等式}}\label{subsec:hilbert-poincare-inequality}

source_text: {The final result we derive is the Poincaré inequality, for which it is necessary to assume that the Hilbert complex is closed.}
translated_text: {最后推导的结论是 Poincaré 不等式, 为此必须假设 Hilbert 复形是闭的.}
